needs_atom.missing: Delayed trigger bound to the triggering object: 'return it to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step' (the creature card that died). DelayedTrigger exists, but the executor's DelayedBinding (executor/binding.py) keeps only source and controller, so the delayed MOVE_ZONE has no referent for 'it' when the end-step event fires (referent='event' would read the end-step event). Also missing: a one-shot 'next end step' lifetime (CR 603.7): the only delayed windows are Eot/UntilNextTurn, so a creature dying during the end step would never return. Mappable: Flying (compiled) and 'Other multicolored creatures you control get +1/+0' (Pack Leader's static with COLOR_COUNT_GE 2).
